items.briefing:
Australian executives are increasingly trusting AI tools despite known audit errors, according to new reporting — a reminder that AI outputs should always be verified before acting on them. Separately, research shows Australian organisations are deploying AI agents faster than proper oversight frameworks are in place, which raises real risks around accountability and data handling.

A general reminder to stay alert to scams remains relevant as Scamwatch activity continues. **Practical tip:** If an AI tool gives you information used in a business decision, always have a person double-check it before acting — AI confidence doesn't equal accuracy.

featured.title: Australian enterprises are scaling agents faster than governance - MCP is the fix
featured.summary: Governance gaps are slowing enterprise AI adoption, with 79% of Australian DevSecOps professionals saying compliance is getting harder.
